questions.title: Drop the Newest Entry
questions.description:
The same cache list also evicts its last (newest) node; with prev pointers the unlink is immediate once you stand on the tail. The class Main and its main method are already provided. Write only the required static method:

    static DNode deleteBack(DNode head)

It must remove the tail node and return the head. The harness prints the list forwards space-separated.

Input Format:
Line 1: n (at least 2). Line 2: n space-separated integers — the list values in order.

Output Format:
One line with the list after eviction, forwards, space-separated.

Constraints:
2 <= n <= 10000, -1000 <= value <= 1000

questions.title: Count Doubly List Nodes
questions.description:
A doubly linked list stores its size implicitly too; walk the next pointers from head to count the nodes. The class Main and its main method are already provided. Write only the required static method:

    static int dllLength(DNode head)

It must return the number of nodes reachable from head.

Input Format:
Line 1: n, the number of nodes. Line 2: n space-separated integers — the node values in order.

Output Format:
One line with the node count.

Constraints:
1 <= n <= 10000, -1000 <= value <= 1000

questions.title: Fill Array Forward
questions.description:
Copying a doubly linked list into an array in natural order is the basic forward walk. The class Main and its main method are already provided. Write only the required static method:

    static void fillForward(DNode head, int[] out)

It must write the node values, in order from head, into out (out.length always equals the list length). The harness prints the filled array space-separated.

Input Format:
Line 1: n. Line 2: n space-separated integers — the node values in order.

Output Format:
One line with the array contents space-separated.

Constraints:
1 <= n <= 10000, -1000 <= value <= 1000

questions.title: Verify Circular Seating
questions.description:
A round-table booking is circular when the last seat's next pointer points back to the first seat. The class Main and its main method are already provided. Write only the required static method:

    static int isCircular(Node head)

It must return 1 when the singly list is circular (the last node's next is head) and 0 when it ends with null.

Input Format:
Line 1: n. Line 2: n space-separated integers — the seat numbers in order. Line 3: flag, 1 when the harness closes the ring (tail.next = head) and 0 when it does not.

Output Format:
One line with 1 or 0.

Constraints:
1 <= n <= 10000, flag is 0 or 1, -1000 <= value <= 1000

questions.title: Reverse Doubly Links
questions.description:
Reversing a doubly linked list rewires BOTH pointers of every node — prev becomes next and next becomes prev — and the tail becomes the head. The class Main and its main method are already provided. Write only the required static method:

    static DNode reverseDll(DNode head)

It must reverse the list in place and return the new head. The harness prints the list forwards space-separated.

Input Format:
Line 1: n. Line 2: n space-separated integers — the node values in order.

Output Format:
One line with the reversed list forwards space-separated.

Constraints:
1 <= n <= 10000, -1000 <= value <= 1000

questions.title: Fill Array Backward
questions.description:
The whole point of prev pointers: start at the tail and walk backwards. The class Main and its main method are already provided. Write only the required static method:

    static void fillBackward(DNode tail, int[] out)

It must write the values in REVERSE order: out[0] gets the last node's data, out[out.length - 1] gets the first node's data. The harness passes the tail node and prints the filled array space-separated.

Input Format:
Line 1: n. Line 2: n space-separated integers — the node values in order.

Output Format:
One line with the array contents (reversed list) space-separated.

Constraints:
1 <= n <= 10000, -1000 <= value <= 1000

questions.title: Sum of Doubly Values
questions.description:
Totalling a doubly linked list works exactly like the singly version — follow next until null. The class Main and its main method are already provided. Write only the required static method:

    static int dllSum(DNode head)

It must return the sum of all node values from head to the end.

Input Format:
Line 1: n. Line 2: n space-separated integers — the node values in order.

Output Format:
One line with the sum.

Constraints:
1 <= n <= 10000, -1000 <= value <= 1000

questions.title: Insert at the Front
questions.description:
Prepending to a doubly linked list means wiring BOTH directions: the new node's next to the old head and the old head's prev back to the new node. The class Main and its main method are already provided. Write only the required static method:

    static DNode insertFront(DNode head, int value)

It must prepend a node holding value and return the new head. The harness prints the list forwards space-separated.

Input Format:
Line 1: n. Line 2: n space-separated integers — the node values in order. Line 3: the value to prepend.

Output Format:
One line with the resulting list forwards space-separated.

Constraints:
1 <= n <= 10000, -1000 <= value <= 1000

questions.title: Insert at the Back
questions.description:
Appending to a doubly linked list: reach the tail, then link the fresh node after it and set its prev. The class Main and its main method are already provided. Write only the required static method:

    static DNode insertBack(DNode head, int value)

It must append a node holding value at the tail and return the head. The harness prints the list forwards space-separated.

Input Format:
Line 1: n. Line 2: n space-separated integers — the node values in order. Line 3: the value to append.

Output Format:
One line with the resulting list forwards space-separated.

Constraints:
1 <= n <= 10000, -1000 <= value <= 1000

questions.title: Carousel Cabin Count
questions.description:
A fairground carousel is modelled as a chain of cabins being assembled cabin by cabin; the operator needs the current count. The class Main and its main method are already provided. Write only the required static method:

    static int dllLength(DNode head)

It must return the number of cabins (nodes) attached so far.

Input Format:
Line 1: n, the number of cabins. Line 2: n space-separated integers — the cabin numbers in order.

Output Format:
One line with the cabin count.

Constraints:
1 <= n <= 10000, 1 <= cabin <= 100000

questions.title: Ledger Balance Total
questions.description:
An accounting ledger keeps its entries in a doubly linked list; closing the books needs the running total. The class Main and its main method are already provided. Write only the required static method:

    static int dllSum(DNode head)

It must return the total of all ledger entries.

Input Format:
Line 1: n, the number of entries. Line 2: n space-separated integers — the entry amounts in order.

Output Format:
One line with the total.

Constraints:
1 <= n <= 10000, -1000 <= amount <= 1000

questions.title: Alert Prepended to Feed
questions.description:
A monitoring feed pins each new alert at the FRONT of a doubly linked list so the newest shows first. The class Main and its main method are already provided. Write only the required static method:

    static DNode insertFront(DNode head, int value)

It must prepend a node holding value (fix both prev and next) and return the new head. The harness prints the feed forwards space-separated.

Input Format:
Line 1: n. Line 2: n space-separated integers — the feed entries in order. Line 3: the new alert code.

Output Format:
One line with the feed forwards space-separated.

Constraints:
1 <= n <= 10000, -1000 <= code <= 1000

questions.title: Order Appended to Queue
questions.description:
A print queue appends each new job at the BACK of a doubly linked list. The class Main and its main method are already provided. Write only the required static method:

    static DNode insertBack(DNode head, int value)

It must append a node holding value at the tail (fix both directions) and return the head. The harness prints the queue forwards space-separated.

Input Format:
Line 1: n. Line 2: n space-separated integers — the queued jobs in order. Line 3: the new job code.

Output Format:
One line with the queue forwards space-separated.

Constraints:
1 <= n <= 10000, -1000 <= code <= 1000

questions.title: Drop the Oldest Entry
questions.description:
A cache list evicts its first (oldest) node; relink the head and clear the evicted node's back-link. The class Main and its main method are already provided. Write only the required static method:

    static DNode deleteFront(DNode head)

It must remove the head node and return the new head. The harness prints the list forwards space-separated.

Input Format:
Line 1: n (at least 2). Line 2: n space-separated integers — the list values in order.

Output Format:
One line with the list after eviction, forwards, space-separated.

Constraints:
2 <= n <= 10000, -1000 <= value <= 1000

questions.title: Kth Cabin from the Rear
questions.description:
Inspecting the carousel from the exit door: instead of re-counting from the front, stand on the tail and walk prev links. The class Main and its main method are already provided. Write only the required static method:

    static int kthFromTail(DNode tail, int k)

It must return the value of the k-th node from the end (1-based), walking prev links only. The harness passes the tail node; k is guaranteed valid.

Input Format:
Line 1: n. Line 2: n space-separated integers — the cabin numbers in order. Line 3: k.

Output Format:
One line with the k-th value from the end.

Constraints:
1 <= n <= 10000, 1 <= k <= n, -1000 <= value <= 1000

questions.title: Remove Defect by Value
questions.description:
A QA sweep unlinks the FIRST node holding a defect value, repairing prev and next around the hole. The class Main and its main method are already provided. Write only the required static method:

    static DNode dllDeleteFirst(DNode head, int target)

It must unlink the FIRST node holding target (do nothing when absent) and return the head. The harness prints the resulting list forwards space-separated.

Input Format:
Line 1: n. Line 2: n space-separated integers — the list values in order. Line 3: the value to remove.

Output Format:
One line with the resulting list forwards space-separated (at least one node always survives).

Constraints:
1 <= n <= 10000, -1000 <= value, target <= 1000

questions.title: Sorted Insert Doubly
questions.description:
A priority chain is kept sorted ascending; a new entry must slide into its slot with both directions rewired. The class Main and its main method are already provided. Write only the required static method:

    static DNode dllInsertSorted(DNode head, int value)

It must insert value so the list stays ascending (after any equal values) and return the (possibly new) head. The harness prints the resulting list forwards space-separated.

Input Format:
Line 1: n. Line 2: n space-separated integers — the sorted values. Line 3: the value to insert.

Output Format:
One line with the resulting list forwards space-separated.

Constraints:
1 <= n <= 10000, -1000 <= value <= 1000

questions.title: Josephus Survivor Seat
questions.description:
n players sit in a circle modelled as a circular doubly linked list of seats. Counting starts at 1 on the head seat and continues around the ring; every k-th remaining player is eliminated by rewiring the circle. The class Main and its main method are already provided. Write only the required static method:

    static int josephus(DNode head, int k)

It must return the seat number of the sole survivor.

Input Format:
Line 1: n. Line 2: n space-separated integers — the seat numbers in circle order (the harness closes the ring for you). Line 3: k.

Output Format:
One line with the surviving seat number.

Constraints:
1 <= n <= 10000, 1 <= k <= n, -1000 <= seat <= 1000

questions.title: Close the Singly Ring
questions.description:
A singly built list must be promoted to a circular ring: link the last node back to the first, then report the last node's data. The class Main and its main method are already provided. Write only the required static method:

    static int makeCircular(Node head)

It must set the last node's next to head and return the last node's data. The harness prints the returned value after verifying the ring; it prints -1 when the list is not circular.

Input Format:
Line 1: n. Line 2: n space-separated integers — the node values in order.

Output Format:
One line with the last node's data once the ring is closed (or -1 if it is not).

Constraints:
1 <= n <= 10000, -1000 <= value <= 1000

questions.title: Swap Kth from Both Ends
questions.description:
A palindrome audit swaps the k-th node from the start with the k-th node from the end of a singly list. The class Main and its main method are already provided. Write only the required static method:

    static Node swapKth(Node head, int k)

It must swap the VALUES of the k-th node from the start and the k-th node from the end (1-based, k <= (n+1)/2) and return the head. When both positions are the same node, the list is unchanged. The harness prints the list space-separated.

Input Format:
Line 1: n. Line 2: n space-separated integers — the list values in order. Line 3: k.

Output Format:
One line with the list after the swap space-separated.

Constraints:
1 <= n <= 10000, 1 <= k <= (n+1)/2, -1000 <= value <= 1000
